txt: As you slam your fist on the button the man collapses entirely, his head rolling to the side...
Don't wait. You've only got a millisecond -- he's coming to, time is breaking loose from the stupor, his left hand curls up into a fist...
He does not so much as glance at the object.
He looks toward the harbour, motionless. The tattoos on his face like a web of stone.
He nods slowly. "AND WHAT YOU HAD TO DO -- WAS TO BECOME A UNION MAN FOR ALL TO SEE."
He surveys the traffic jam, then turns his eyes back to you. Waiting, prepared...

He turns to you. "BASIC RACIST, I TAKE PITY ON YOU. YOU CLEARLY WANT TO ENTER THE HARBOUR BAD. LIKE A LITTLE BOY WHO WANTS TO GO ON THE POTTY. I CAN PRESS THE BUTTON FOR YOU -- IT WILL OPEN THE DOOR."

He turns to you. "DEGENERATE SOCIAL DEMOCRAT, I TAKE PITY ON YOU. YOU CLEARLY WANT TO ENTER THE HARBOUR BAD. LIKE A LITTLE BOY WHO WANTS TO GO ON THE POTTY. I CAN PRESS THE BUTTON FOR YOU -- IT WILL OPEN THE DOOR."

He turns to you. "EFFEMINATE GOSSIP-MONGERER, I TAKE PITY ON YOUR TABLOID DRIVEN URGES. YOU CLEARLY WANT TO ENTER THE HARBOUR *BAD*, LIKE A LITTLE BOY WHO WANTS TO GO ON THE POTTY. I CAN PRESS THE BUTTON FOR YOU -- IT WILL OPEN THE DOOR."

He turns to you. "IMPOTENT CLASS WARRIOR, I TAKE PITY ON YOU. YOU CLEARLY WANT TO ENTER THE HARBOUR BAD. LIKE A LITTLE BOY WHO WANTS TO GO ON THE POTTY. I CAN PRESS THE BUTTON FOR YOU -- IT WILL OPEN THE DOOR."

He turns to you. "IMPOTENT SUBJECT OF POP CULTURE, I TAKE PITY ON YOU. YOU CLEARLY WANT TO ENTER THE HARBOUR BAD -- LIKE A LITTLE BOY WANTS TO GO ON THE POTTY. I CAN PRESS THE BUTTON FOR YOU -- IT WILL OPEN THE DOOR."

He turns to you. "NIHILISTIC SEX MANIAC, I TAKE PITY ON YOUR URGES. YOU CLEARLY WANT TO ENTER THE HARBOUR *BAD,* LIKE A LITTLE BOY WHO WANTS TO GO ON THE POTTY. I CAN PRESS THE BUTTON FOR YOU -- IT WILL OPEN THE DOOR."
He turns to you. "YOU COULD HAVE USED THIS OPPORTUNITY TO OVERCOME YOUR NARROW, *AL GUL* RAVAGED IDENTITY. INSTEAD OF UNLOCKING THE RACE ENIGMA, YOU ATTEMPTED TO *ADD* TO IT -- UNSUCCESSFULLY."
Measurehead stoically looks to the distance -- in silence.
The man is reeling, gasping for air, time stands still around you. In the distance the sounds of the harbour are falling silent.
The man is still knocked out. He breathes slowly and steadily.

The man lands with a dull thump, like a broken down puppet of muscles and sinew. For a moment he still tries to keep his head up, dazed eyes looking at you with unimaginable surprise.... To your left is *The Button.*
The man looks at you, silent and unmoving. His eyes burrow into the remnants of your soul.
The statueesque giant seems to have already forgotten your presence. He's deep in thought, eyes scanning the horizon...
Then he continues: "THE LATTER IS PERFECTED AND ADAPTING. TOGETHER THEY FORM THE SEMENO-AREOPAGITE OR *SEMEOPAGITE* SUPERRACE -- THAT IS ALL. THERE ARE NO MORE TYPE A RACES IN THE WORLD."
"A MEDIAN AMOUNT OF TIME."
"A PIECE OF ADVICE..." The big man leans forward. "STOP FIGHTING TIME AND FACE THE *REAL* ANTAGONIST. FACE *YOURSELF*, PUPA. IT'S A SHOWDOWN EVERY MAN MUST GO THROUGH."
"A RECEDING GENETIC POOL HAS LED THE MAUN ON REPREHENSIBLE STREET PARADES, IN MAUN CITIES LIKE STAADSKANAAL AND VREDEFORT, WEARING WOODEN CLOGS ON THEIR FEET, AND LITTLE GREEN TASSELS ON THEIR HATS."

"ABOVE ALL -- RAMPANT MULTINATIONAL FINANCE STILL REIGNING LARGE. TELL ME, WHERE HAVE YOU GOTTEN YOUR LOVE OF PATHETIC COMMUNISM FROM?" He leans closer. "DEGENERATE YOUTH CULTURE? ROCK AND ROLL MUSIC?"
"AL GUL IS AN ANCIENT IILMARAAN POISON, A PARASITIC FUNGUS THAT HAS COLONIZED YOUR RACE. IT IS A TRICK THE DESERT PYGMEES PLAYED ON YOU -- FOR HUMILIATING THEM AND STRIPPING THEM OF THEIR LAND."
"ALSO -- TO SERVE IS NOBLE, IT TAKES DISCIPLINE. YOUR PETULANT INDIVIDUALISM HAS ONLY CONTRIBUTED TO YOUR *RACE FAILURE*. IT IS LAX AND MORONIC."
"AN EMPTY VESSEL THE MIND HAS DESERTED. A HUSK, NO LONGER INHABITED BY A CONSCIOUSNESS. BIOLOGICAL WASTE."
"AND REMEMBER. WHAT HAPPENS IN MY MOM'S OFFICE, STAYS IN MY MOM'S OFFICE. QUIET CONTEMPLATION ENDS, BIOLOGICAL RIVALRY RESUMES."
"AND THE COUCH. THE COUCH IS VERY COMFORTABLE, EVEN THOUGH IT IS VERY SMALL. THERE IS NO COUCH LIKE THIS ONE."
"AND THE WOMEN. WOMEN WHO SHAVE AND ARE CAPABLE OF UNDERSTANDING CONCEPTS LIKE POLYAMORY AND *COITUS CASUALIS* -- THE KOJKO AND THEIR PROMISCUITY ARE AT THE FOREFRONT OF ALL THAT."
"AND YET YOU'RE STILL OBSESSED WITH TURNING BACK TIME? AFTER YOU'VE SEEN WHAT IT DOES TO A MAN?"
"AND, OF COURSE, YOU WILL NOT BE ABLE TO FREE YOURSELF FROM THE YOKE OF *GUL*. IT IS TOO LATE. IT MAY BE LETHAL TO STOP AT THIS POINT, BUT STILL..." He pauses in heroic doubt.
"AND? THAT'S WHAT YOU WANTED TO TALK ABOUT? THAT YOU ARE A DISTURBED GENDER PARITY ACTIVIST?"
"AND? THAT'S WHAT YOU WANTED TO TALK ABOUT? THAT YOU DON'T LIKE WOMEN?"
"AND? THAT'S WHAT YOU WANTED TO TALK ABOUT?"
"AND?"
"ANYTHING FOR YOU, BABE." He looks to a space right above your head and gestures you to speak.
"ANYTHING IS POSSIBLE. JUST NOT FOR YOU."
"ARE YOU ADMIRING MY MORPHOPHYSIOLOGY?" A ripple of muscle passes underneath his skin. He lets you look.
"AS PROVEN BY THE MAUN AND THE MESQUE, OCCIDENTAL TYPE A IS IN RETROGRADE; THE SEMENESE AND THE AREOPAGITE ARE ON THE ASCENT."

"BABE, LOOK." His arm reaches out, palm open as if giving a demonstration. "SCORCHED BIOMASS IS ALL THAT THE GHOUL LEFT OF HIS BRAIN. SOON HE WILL DEVOLVE INTO AN ANDROGYNOUS BI-PEDAL, ABLE TO PERFORM ONLY THE MOST INSTINCTUAL OF FUNCTIONS."
"BABE, SEE THAT THEY STAY HERE THE WHOLE TIME."
"BABE, THANKS." The tattoos on his stone face briefly form a smile. "BUT I GOT THIS."
"BECAUSE FATHER JAIRZINHO IS MY FATHER AND HIS NAME IS JAIRZINHO."

"BEFORE YOU GO LOOKING FOR TICKETS, I SUGGEST YOU SEE WHAT IT DOES TO A MAN. THE GHOUL IS A CRUEL MASTER, BUT IT IS NOT PALE. PALE TAKES YOUR MIND AND REJECTS THE FLESH. IT IS CAPRICIOUS AND TERRIFYING, LIKE A VIRGIN. YOU WILL LOSE YOUR COURAGE BEFORE HER FACE."
"BEGGING FOR HELP. ATTEMPTING TO PASS FEAR FOR COOPERATION. HOW FAR THE OCCIDENTAL HAPLOGROUP HAS FALLEN..." He pauses in melancholy reflection. "YOU WERE ONCE A NOBLE AND POWERFUL RACE."
"BRING YOUR TROOPS TO THE SEMENINE ISLANDS AND TO BOOGIE STREET AND WE WILL PULVERIZE YOU. WHEN YOU ARE GONE WE WILL BUILD A MUSEUM FOR YOU."
"BUT ENOUGH. IT IS CRUEL TO ENTERTAIN OURSELVES WITH THE DEFORMITIES OF TYPE C-F. WERE THERE ANY ABLE BODIED RACES YOU NEEDED EDUCATION ON?"
"BUT YOU DID. AND THEN YOUR TESTICLES SHRUNK AND RETREATED INSIDE YOUR RECTUM."
"BUT." He leans in and intones: "WHILE I AM GONE SOMEONE MUST STAND GUARD ON THE BRIDGE. THAT SOMEONE NEEDS TO BE *YOU*."

"CLEARLY IT IS IMPOSSIBLE FOR YOU TO SHED YOUR NEUROTIC OBSESSION. THIS WAILING FOR THE PAST IS A TASK UNFIT FOR MEN. IT IS BETTER LEFT FOR WIDOWS, MOURNING THEIR HUSBANDS -- AND FOR MENTALLY ILL COMMUNISTS MOURNING THEIR COMMUNE."
"COME BACK TO ME WHEN YOU'VE MASTERED THE RHIZOME." He crosses his arms, towering above you with a menacing shadow.
"COMPLETE *PUSSY*."
"CONTINUOUS DENIAL. YOUR LACK OF PSYCHOSEXUAL SELF-AWARENESS DOES NOT SURPRISE ME. SOMETHING TRAGIC MUST HAVE HAPPENED TO YOU IN THE PAST FOR YOU TO DENY IT SO VIGOROUSLY."
"CORRECT, MY SMALL-SKULLED SERVANT." He nods approvingly.
"CORRECT."

"DEMOCRATIC ETHNOSTATES ARE MICROSCOPIC. THEY BREED GENETIC MEDIOCRITY. THE SEMENO-AREOPAGITE SUPERSTATE WILL COVER THE *ENTIRE* REMAINING PLANETARY CRUST, UNINTERRUPTED FROM HOLY SEMENINE TO THE BOREAL PLATEAU OF KATLA."
"DESPERATION. WISHFUL THINKING. CONFUSION. NO WOMAN WANTS TO CREATE A LASTING PSYCHOSEXUAL BOND WITH A MAN IN THRALL TO HIS BIOLOGICAL IMPULSES."
"DO NOT BE NAIVE. I KNOW THE ANSWER TO THE GREAT RACE ENIGMA. WHY WOULD I SHARE IT WITH A DEFORMED INFANT? YOU DO NOT HAVE THE DEVOTION FOR SERVITUDE."
"DO NOT PRESUME THIS HAS DRASTICALLY ALTERED OUR RACE DYNAMIC."
"DO NOT THINK ME INTRODUCING YOU TO RACE SCIENCE MEANS I'M NOW PART OF YOUR *GROWING* PROCESS -- IT DOES NOT LOOK PROMISING."
"DO NOT THINK THE SERENITY OF MY MOTHER'S OFFICE MAKES ME FORGET WE ARE BIOLOGICAL COMPETITORS -- ALBEIT UNEVENLY MATCHED."
"DO YOU KNOW WHO HAS ABSOLUTELY *NO* RESPECT FOR THIS TYPE OF PHYSIOLOGICAL METAMORPHOSIS?"
"DON'T APOLOGISE. MY WOMEN LIKED IT. IT IS IMPORTANT TO APPEAR VULNERABLE SOMETIMES. VULNERABILITY NURTURES EMOTIONAL CONTACT."
"DON'T BE VULGAR. WHITE OR NOT HAS GOT LITTLE TO DO WITH THIS. THE *RACE ENIGMA* RUNS MUCH DEEPER THAN THAT." He turns his eyes towards the harbour, seemingly bored with you.
"DON'T PANIC, HAM SANDWICH. THAT WAS A JOKE. WE'RE GOING TO MY MOTHER'S OFFICE."
"DON'T THINK NOW THAT YOU'VE DIVORCED YOURSELF FROM THE GHOUL YOU'RE FIT TO GIVE ME LIFE ADVICE."
"DON'T WORRY, BABE. THIS WON'T TAKE LONG."
"EMOTIONAL CONTACT AMPLIFIES THE ECSTASIES OF SEX. LIKE IVY, WE ARE INTERTWINED. WEAK AND STRONG, MAN AND WOMAN, MOTHER AND CHILD.
"ENOUGH OF TYPE B MEDIOCRITY," he nods, satisfied with the outcome.
"ENOUGH WITH THIS BEGGING. YOU SHOULD LEAVE THE STAGE OF HISTORY WITH DIGNITY -- BY INVITING THE OTHER RACES TO A *GREAT WORLD WAR*."
"EVERYONE CAN SEE THAT. IT HAS LITTLE TO DO WITH THE *RACE ENIGMA*."
"FAREWELL, HAM SANDWICH. YOU ARE A UNION MAN FROM NOW ON."
"FASCINATING..." The phrenologic lines on his face move like a puzzle board: "THE REVACHOLIAN DEGENERATE SHOWS SIGNS OF RACIAL SELF REFLECTION. HOW DID YOU ACCOMPLISH THIS LITTLE FEAT?"
"FATHER JAIRZINHO MADE ME HARD, WHERE MY MOTHER MADE ME SOFT. TOGETHER THEY MADE ME COMPLETE."
"FATHER JAIRZINHO WAS VERY WISE. HE REALISED THAT IF THE TENDER TOUCH OF MY MOTHER WASN'T OPPOSED I WOULD TURN INTO A..." He pauses to make sure your eyes are locked.
"FIND OUT FOR YOURSELF, ENDOMORPHIC BLOB."
"FINE. GOOD-BYE. RETURN TO YOUR DEGENERACY."
"FINE. THEY HAVE RECENTLY FALLEN UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF A POSSIBLY SEXUALLY PERVERTED FEMALE VAGRANT AND A NARCOTICS PEDDLER. IT'S SHAMEFUL."
"GO HAVE A LOOK," he gestures toward the intersection. "THE WHITE-HAIRED PROTEIN MASS AT THE INTERSECTION. A LORRY DRIVER. IMPOSSIBLE TO MISS HER IF YOU'RE EVEN A HALF-DECENT COP."
"GO TALK WITH HER AGAIN. ASK HER ABOUT PALE. SEE WHAT A RELENTLESS OBSESSION WITH THE PAST DOES TO A MAN."
"GOOD, THERE IS A *FRITTTE* NEARBY. CONGRATULATE YOURSELF WITH ANOTHER DRINK. YOUR FEATURES ARE NOT YET CONGENITALLY DEFORMED ENOUGH."
"GOOD." He releases your hand. "NOW LEAVE, BEFORE YOU HUMILIATE YOUR HOMO-EROTIC ORGANISATION ANY FURTHER."
"GOOD." He releases your small hand. "NOW GO. BEFORE YOU ENTER CARDIAC ARREST."
"GOOD."
"GREAT TIMES WERE HAD HERE, FILLING IN THE GREAT COLOURING BOOK OF THE SEMENINE FLORA AND FAUNA. THE CARRION FLOWERS AND THE MONOTREMES. THE MANGROVE FORESTS AND THE MEGABATS."
"HIS RAGE IS ALREADY PLAYED OUT ON THE STAGE OF HISTORY -- AS THE GROTESQUE TRAGEDY OF REVOLUTION. ALL IT CAN ACCOMPLISH NOW IS IMPOTENT ACADEMIC TEXT AND NEUROSYPHILITIC ROCK AND ROLL MELANCHOLIA."

"I AM A DESCENDANT. THE NARROW STREETS OF ULUNBUIR ARE WITH ME IN MY GENETIC DREAMS, I SEE YOUNG SEMENESE WOMEN WALK INTO THE GREY MASS ON *ILE DU FANTÔME*, WAITING ON IMMACULATE CONCEPTION FROM THE PALE."
"I AM JUST STATING THE FACTS. YOUR TRAUMATIZED ESSENCE IS IN PLAIN SIGHT."
"I AM MERELY OFFERING A SMALL GLIMPSE OF FUNCTIONAL FAMILY DYNAMICS -- SOMETHING YOU WERE CLEARLY DEPRIVED OF."

"I AM NOT A *TRADITIONAL* TRADITIONALIST. LIFE ON THIS PLANET DOES NOT MOVE BACKWARDS. THE IVY MOVES FORWARD, COVERING THE WHOLE DOOR. THE FLOWERS GROW OUTWARD, COVERING THE WHOLE MEADOW. NOTHING GROWS *AGAINST* TIME AND SPACE. ONLY ALONG ITS LAYLINES CAN NATURE PROGRESS."
"I AM NOT GOING ANYWHERE -- AND NEITHER IS MY MOTHER'S OFFICE."
"I AM NOT LIKE THEM. I AM CRANIOMETRIC PERFECTION. I HAVE TAKEN THE TROUBLE TO PERMANENTLY DRAW A PHRENOLOGIC GRID ON MY SKULL AND FEATURES. THIS SHOULD DISPEL ANY DOUBT."
"I AM NOT SURPRISED YOU ENJOY IT SO MUCH. THIS HAS HAPPENED TO MANY OF THE SIDE-PRODUCTS OF THE INEVITABLE CULTURAL VICTORY OF THE SEMENESE RACE."

"I AM NOT SURPRISED. YOU ARE LIKE THE RUNT OF THE LITTER, ABANDONED. INCAPABLE OF NURTURING A WOMAN'S LOVE. OUR MOTHERS ARE THE ONES WHO TEACH US TO RECEIVE AFFECTION FROM THE OPPOSITE SEX -- A BOND YOU HAVE CLEARLY NOT EXPERIENCED."

"I AM NOT THE FIRST LINE OF DEFENCE -- I AM THE LAST." He looks toward the coast, defiantly. "IN ADDITION, THESE SO-CALLED *HARDIE BOYS* ARE AN EFFEMINATE CLIQUE OF BODYBUILDERS. THEIR COMPANY IS SPIRITUALLY DEGRADING."
"I CAN BARELY HEAR YOUR WORDS THROUGH THE VOICE OF AL-GUL, BUT IT SPEAKS TRUTH. MEN ONLY WANT TO REVERSE TIME FOR ONE REASON -- LOVE."

"I CAN SEE THAT. THE SEMENESE ARE THE SOUTH ISLAND RACE. HAPLOGROUP A4A, THE RIGHTFUL MASTERS OF THE INSULINDIAN ARCHIPELAGO. WE DESCEND FROM THE AREOPAGITES OF ANCIENT PERIKARNASSIS -- AND ARRIVED HERE 4000 YEARS AGO."
"I CAN SEE YOU WERE ONCE AN ATHLETE. THEN DETERIORATED IN YOUR TWENTIES. IT IS TYPICAL OF YOUR HAPLOGROUP. LET'S BLAME THE FAILED EDUCATION SYSTEM AND LENIENCY TOWARD DEGENERATES IN YOUR HOMELAND."
"I CAN'T SEE OR HEAR THE GREAT EXAMPLE YOU'RE SETTING OVER THE DEAFENING ROAR OF YOUR CO-PILOT, AL GUL."
"I CANNOT POSSIBLY IMAGINE WHAT ELSE WE HAVE TO DISCUSS, TYPE B REVACHOLIAN -- YOUR LOVE FOR DISCO MUSIC AND VENEREAL DISEASE?"
"I DIDN'T BECOME WHAT I AM BY SUCCUMBING TO THE PLEASURE-SEEKING DEMANDS OF MY PHYSICAL BODY. YOU HOWEVER CLEARLY DID -- AND THAT'S MORE THAN I NEED TO CLOSE THIS ARGUMENT."
"I DOUBT IT, MY MICROCEPHALIC RACE SERVANT."
"I HAVE RETURNED WITH THE HAM SANDWICH. LOOK, HE IS ALIVE. I HAVE NOT HARMED THIS LITTLE COP."
"I JUST TOLD YOU. IT’S NOT MEANT FOR AN AL-GUL ENTHRALLED MIND LIKE YOURS."
"I JUST TOLD YOU. YOU DON'T. IT'S NOT MEANT FOR A FEEBLE AND TRAUMATIZED MIND LIKE YOURS."
"I KNEW YOU WOULD GO STRAIGHT FOR THE VILE CAULDRON -- EVERYONE DOES." He does not look surprised. "YOU NEED TO FIRST LEARN ABOUT TYPE A AND B TO APPRECIATE THE DEPRAVITY OF THE CHIMERIC RACES."
"I KNOW, BABE."

"I'M FROM COURON..." He changes tactics: "AND NO, IT IS NOT *JUST* IN REVACHOL. THIS CITY IS CENTRAL TO THE SEMENESE STRATEGY. SPREADING THROUGH ITS TRADE NETWORKS OUR CULTURE WILL DOMINATE THE WORLD."
"I'M GOING TO DO YOU A KINDNESS, PUPA. I'M GOING TO SHARE A SECRET WITH YOU. HERE IS THE SECRET: THERE IS NO LOVE IN THE PAST. ONLY THE PRESENT."

"IDIOTIC COMMUNISM IS THE SINGLE GREATEST CONTRIBUTOR TO YOUR RACE DESCENT. EVERYWHERE AROUND YOU, THE FRUITS OF ITS FAILURE TO CHALLENGE THE WORLD ORDER: INDIVIDUALISM, ROCK AND ROLL MUSIC, SEXUALLY TRANSMITTED DISEASES..."
"IF DISCUSSING BODILY FUNCTIONS DISTURBS YOU, WE CAN TALK ABOUT SOMETHING ELSE. SOMETHING THAT CORRESPONDS BETTER WITH YOU EMOTIONAL IMMATURITY."
"IF THE REVACHOLIAN DEGENERATE IS CAPABLE OF CRITICAL THOUGHT HE MAY PROVE A *RACE ADVERSARY* YET -- WAS I MISTAKEN TO SHARE THE ESOTERIC SCIENCE WITH HIM?"

"IF THE REVACHOLIAN DEGENERATE IS CAPABLE OF CRITICAL THOUGHT HE MAY STILL PROVE A *RACE ADVERSARY* -- WHY SHOULD I HELP MY ADVERSARY?" He looks at the red button, seeking council from his own ideals.
"IF YOU WANT ADVICE ON BABES -- OR THE MYSTERIES OF LIFE -- OR EVEN ON REVACHOL -- LOOK FORWARD. TO ESCAPE YOUR DEFEATED STATE YOU NEED TO MOVE FORWARD. ONTO FUTURE VICTORIES."

"IN A BIOLOGICAL SENSE, THE MAN WHOSE ESSENCE, WHOSE GENETIC BLUEPRINT, IS PASSED ON TO THE MOST HOSTS, DOWN TO THE MOST GENERATIONS, FULFILS HIS BIOLOGICAL PURPOSE TO THE GREATEST EXTENT. THIS IS THE LOVE VICTORY."
"IN FACT VISUAL EXPRESSION OF INDIVIDUALITY IS SOMETHING WE ALWAYS PERCEIVED DIFFERENTLY. IT'S A GENERATIONAL CHASM."
"INANE POPULAR CULTURE LINGO. IT IS INTELLECTUALLY *UNINTERESTING* TO 'SOCK' ANYTHING TO AN INFANT SUCH AS YOU."
"INGEST AND DEFECATE, LIKE AN OVERWEIGHT AMOEBA."
"INSTEAD YOU HAVE DEVELOPED THIS UNHEALTHY OBSESSION WITH BABES. ANY BABES, MINE INCLUDED. THIS IS NOT THE ANSWER."
"INSTEAD YOU HAVE DEVELOPED THIS UNHEALTHY OBSESSION WITH THE PAST. STANDING BEFORE ME, HOPING TO TURN BACK TIME. THIS IS NOT THE ANSWER. REINVENT YOURSELF FROM DEFEAT."

"IT DOES NOT SURPRISE ME THAT THE COMPLEXITIES OF THE PSYCHOSEXUAL BOND BETWEEN A MAN AND A WOMAN REMAIN BEYOND YOUR REACH. INSTEAD YOU CONTINUE TO IDEALISE THE FLAWED AND HALLUCINATORY RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN YOUR PARENTS, HOPING TO CORRECT THEIR MISTAKES."
"IT IS FAR MORE MASCULINE TO PASS ON A BLUEPRINT OF YOUR MIND AND YOUR SPIRIT THAN YOUR FLESH. WOMEN GIVE BIRTH TO FLESH AND MEN GIVE BIRTH TO SPIRIT. SPIRIT IS IMMORTAL."

"IT IS IMPOSSIBLE TO SEE ANY MORE OF YOUR BONE STRUCTURE -- IT IS COVERED IN THE RAVAGES OF AL GUL. FROM WHAT REMAIN OF YOUR FEATURES, I CAN SEE *FLESHY LIPS*, *BALDNESS OF THE HEAD*, AND LONG ARMS RELATIVE TO LOWER LIMBS."
"IT IS MY TASK TO KEEP THE DEGENERATE DRUNKS FROM ENTERING THE HARBOUR."

"IT IS. BENEATH THE VENEER OF ACADEMIC JARGON THE LIBERAL THEORIST IS A BEAST, A SEXUAL MANIAC AND A DEPRAVED NIHILIST. LIFE IS A *GAME* TO HIM. WORDS ARE MEANINGLESS. NO ONE IS ACCOUNTABLE FOR ANYTHING."
"IT MUST BE FRIGHTENING TO STAND IN THE SHADOW OF THIS *RACIAL PINNACLE*. BE CALM, HAM SANDWICH. YOU ARE NOT IN DANGER, BECAUSE YOU ARE NOT A THREAT TO ME."
"IT SADDENS EVEN ME. THE GHOUL IS A CRUEL MASTER."

"IT SEEMS TO ME YOU ARE IN NEED OF A WARNING. HERE IT IS: IT IS ABSOLUTELY POSSIBLE TO RETURN TO THE PAST. YOU JUST NEED TO TAKE A TICKET TO SEREGLEE ISLAND, THE SOUTHERNMOST OF THE SEMENINE ARCHIPELAGO, ALSO KNOWN AS ILE DU FANTÔME. AND WALK INTO PALE."
"IT WILL SERVE YOU POORLY IN THE GREAT WAR OF LOVE."
"IT WOULD BE CRUEL." The man agrees. "TO ENTERTAIN OURSELVES WITH THEIR DEFORMITIES. WERE THERE ANY ABLE BODIED RACES YOU NEEDED EDUCATION ON?"
"IT'S NOT TOO LATE YET TO CHANGE THE COURSE. GIVE UP ON AL GUL. THEN GO EVEN FURTHER. REINVENT YOURSELF FROM DEFEAT."
"IT'S NOT TOO LATE YET TO CHANGE THE COURSE. YOU HAVE ALREADY GIVEN UP ON AL GUL. NOW GO FURTHER. REINVENT YOURSELF FROM DEFEAT."
"IT'S NOTHING TO BE PROUD OF, PUPA. HYSTERICAL MASTURBATION IS BUT ONE OF THE MANY ILLNESSES OF OCCIDENTAL CIVILISATION."
"IT'S SIMPLE. I AM JUST NOT INTERESTED IN YOUR IMPOTENT OBSESSION WITH THE PAST."
"ITS LEADERS WILL BE THE GENETIC EPITOME OF THE SEMENESE AND AREOPAGITE STOCK, ELECTED BY NATURE; NOT THE BASE, INERT SPOILAGE CALLED *DEMOS*."
"JAM. INDIVIDUALISM. YOU HAVE GOTTEN THESE IDEAS FROM DEGENERATE YOUTH CULTURE, HAVE YOU NOT? YOU HAVE PICKED THEM UP FROM ROCK AND ROLL SONGS?"
"JERKING MOTIONS. SIGNS OF A LATE-STAGE NEURODEGENERATIVE DISORDER. HOW FAR THE OCCIDENTAL HAPLOGROUP HAS FALLEN..." He pauses in melancholy reflection. "YOU WERE ONCE A NOBLE AND POWERFUL RACE."
"LAST WE SAW, YOUR RACE WAS BEING SUPERSEDED BY THE SEMENESE."

"LESSER RACES LIKE THE *MESQUITO*, A GROTESQUE MIXTURE OF A MESQUE WOMAN AND A SEMENESE MAN, ONLY POSSIBLE IF THE MOTHER IS MESQUE AND THE FATHER SEMENESE. THE OTHER WAY AROUND THEY FAIL TO PRODUCE OFFSPRING."
"LET IT DITHER AND ROT YOUR MIND. THEN YOU CAN MARINATE FOREVER IN YOUR IRREVERSABLE DEFEAT. WHILE RACE ENEMIES LAUGH AT YOUR MOTIONLESS, GAP-MOUTHED CORPSE."
"LET ME SAY THAT AGAIN: IT IS THE *BALANCE* BETWEEN SOFT AND HARD THAT MADE ME COMPLETE."
"LISTEN TO YOUR LITTLE FRIEND. HE IS WISE IN HIS CHILDLIKE WAY. HIS MYSTERIOUS RACE MAY YET PROVE FIERCE COMPETITION TO MY HEROIC HAPLOGROUP."
"LOOK AROUND YOU. LOOK AT THE ADVANCEMENTS IN THE SEXUAL SCIENCES -- ALL THE NOVEL TECHNIQUES, ACCESSORIES, PRESERVATIVES, MASSAGE OILS, LUBRICATION SALVES, ABORTION CLINICS..."

"LOOK AT MY CRANIOLOGY. I AM THE PINNACLE OF MY HAPLOGROUP. THE PINK BLOB IS A BAD EXAMPLE EVEN OF YOURS. IT SADDENS ME..." He pauses in melancholy reflection. "YOU WERE ONCE A NOBLE AND POWERFUL RACE."
"LOOK BABE, THE PETULANT ROCK AND ROLL REBEL THINKS THE RACIAL SYNTHESIS EXISTS TO *RANKLE* HIS SENSIBILITIES. IN HIS HALL-OF-MIRRORS EXISTENCE, EVERYTHING IS INSINCERE -- EVEN NATURE."
"LOOK BABE, WHEN CONFRONTED WITH THE HARSH TRUTH OF HIS DEMISE THE MELANCHOLIC ACADEMICIAN STARTS FIDDLING HIS OWN GENITALIA. HIS BALD SPOT BETRAYS THAT HE IS A COMPULSIVE MASTURBATOR."
"LOOK, BABE, THE MINION OF LAW IS ALSO A RACIST. BUT HIS RACISM IS BASIC AND ROTE. HE THINKS HE HAS SOLVED THE GREAT RACE *ENIGMA* BY DESCRIBING A ROTE MECHANISM OF SCIENTIFIC COMPETITION."

"LOOK, BABE, WHEN CONFRONTED WITH THE DEMISE OF HIS ENTIRE RACE, THE BOURGEOIS ALCOHOLIC DEGENERATE FOCUSES ON GOSSIP. OTHER PEOPLE'S LIVES ARE A REFUGE FOR HIM -- FROM THE BURNING RACE WRECKAGE OF HIS OWN."
"LOOK, BABE. THE DISCO DANCING DEGENERATE HAS RUN OUT OF COCAINE TO SHOOT INTO HIS ARMS. THIS HAS MADE HIM SHORT FUSED AND IMPOLITE. UNDERNEATH THE POSTURING, THERE IS DREAD."
"LOOK, BABE. THE FOSSILIZED ROCK AND ROLL REBEL CHALLENGES ME -- A FIGURE OF AUTHORITY. HE IS TRYING TO REINSTATE HIS INDIVIDUALISM WITH SWEARWORDS TAKEN FROM ROCK SONGS FROM THE LAST CENTURY."
"LOOK, BABE. THE RICH-MAN HAS HUMILIATED AND EMASCULATED THIS *COPLET*. HE CAN ONLY THINK IN BASE MATERIALIST CATEGORIES AND FEMININE ABSTRACTIONS LIKE MONEY."
"LOOK, HIS RAVAGED BRAIN IS STUCK BETWEEN UNIMAGINARY WORLD -- AND OURS. IT'S ALL FUSING TOGETHER. SOON HE CAN'T TELL THE DIFFERENCE."
"LOST DOE, BUCKLED AWAY AT THE LAST GATE -- THIS IS WHY YOUR HAPLOGROUP WILL NEVER RISE FROM THE ASHES. NOW -- I NEED TO LUXURIATE IN THE PRIVATE COMPANY OF MY BABE. LEAVE ME."
"MANAGED TO LEARN THE REALITY RHIZOME -- AND NEXT UP IS RETURNING TO THE PAST?" The giant locks eyes with you. His face is serious...

"MAYBE IT'S FOR THE BEST. IT IS TOO LATE TO EXPLAIN THE INTRICACIES OF THE REALITY-RHIZOME IF THE OPPORTUNITY TO LEARN ITS FUNDAMENTAL TERMS HAS PASSED YOU. TREAT THE PALE AS A MYSTERY -- DARK, REPULSIVE, AND SURPRISINGLY MUNDANE -- LIKE CURDLING MILK OR A MOULDING NECTARINE."

"MEN ONLY WANT TO REVERSE TIME FOR ONE REASON. THEY *SAY* IT'S ABOUT HONOUR, JUSTICE, REVENGE, REGRET, REDEMPTION, AND A PLETHORA OF FALSE REASONS, BUT FURTHER BACK -- DEEPER IN -- IT IS ALWAYS LOVE THAT DRIVES THEM."
"MR. CLAIRE IS A MAN OF VISION AND MEANS. HE HAS THE WILL TO CONFRONT INTERNATIONAL CAPITAL, WHICH IS SOMETHING YOUR RACE NAIVISTIC COMMUNISTS NEVER DID."
"MR. CLAIRE IS A MAN OF VISION AND MEANS. HE HAS THE WILL TO CONFRONT POLYCULTURAL CAPITAL -- SOMETHING *YOUR* RACE NAIVISTIC COMMUNISTS NEVER DID."
"MY MOTHER WILL *NEVER* DIE."
"NO, HE DOES NOT, BUT IT DOESN'T MATTER. I SHOULDN'T CARE -- AND I DON'T -- WHAT HE THINKS. I AM MYSELF, NOT HIM. THIS IS HOW HE TAUGHT ME."
"NO, I AM NOT."

"NO, THOSE WERE SCIMITAR WIELDING RACE LOSERS OF SAHRAVA, YEESUT AND BASHIR, WITH THEIR HIMI SERVANTS. *BIG DIFFERENCE*. THE AREOPAGITES WERE FASTING AND CONQUERING WHILE THIS HAPPENED -- YOU NEVER PENETRATED THE WESTERN DUNES."
